items.f0: What is the first step in a business dispute?
items.f1: The first step is a comprehensive case evaluation to understand your objectives and review all relevant documentation. We then advise on the most strategic path — negotiation, mediation, or litigation.

items.f0: How do I schedule a consultation?
items.f1: Call us at +250 790 750 000, email info.blaw223@yahoo.com, or click "Book Consultation" on our website. We offer both in-person and virtual meetings.

items.f0: Do you offer virtual / online consultations?
items.f1: Yes. We offer consultations via phone and video call. Simply mention your preference when booking and our team will arrange the most convenient format for you.

items.f0: How long does a typical case take?
items.f1: Duration depends on complexity, area of law, and whether it proceeds to litigation or ADR. We provide a realistic timeline estimate specific to your matter during the initial consultation.

items.f0: How do you structure your fees?
items.f1: We offer hourly rates, flat fees, or contingency arrangements depending on the matter. All costs are clearly outlined before engagement — no surprises. Try our Fee Estimator for a guide.
We offer a brief initial consultation to understand your matter and explain how we can help. Any extended consultation fees are clearly communicated in advance.

items.f0: What payment methods do you accept?
items.f1: We accept bank transfers, mobile money (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money), and cash at our office. Payment plans may be available for qualifying clients.

items.f0: Do you offer services for startups and new companies?
items.f1: Yes. We have a dedicated team for enterprise formation, compliance, and IP protection, ensuring your business is built on a solid legal foundation from day one.

items.f0: Can you help with company registration in Rwanda?
items.f1: Absolutely. We handle the complete registration process through the Rwanda Development Board (RDB), including documentation, shareholder agreements, and regulatory compliance.

items.f0: Do you handle cross-border and international matters?
items.f1: Yes. We have extensive experience with cross-border commercial transactions, international trade agreements, and multi-jurisdictional disputes, collaborating with partner firms across the region.

items.f0: How do you handle sensitive family matters?
items.f1: We approach all family matters — divorce, custody, and asset division — with utmost discretion, sensitivity, and a focus on long-term stability for all parties, especially children.

items.f0: What is estate planning and do I need it?
items.f1: Estate planning prepares for the legal management and distribution of your assets. If you own property or have dependents, it is essential. We handle wills, trusts, and inheritance arrangements.
